sentences.en: The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.
sentences.zh: 计算机行业的发展非常迅速。

sentences.en: It must be dangerous to swim in this rapid stream.
sentences.zh: 在这种湍急的溪流里游泳一定很危险。

sentences.en: Juvenile delinquency is on the increase at a rapid pace.
sentences.zh: 青少年犯罪呈快速上升趋势。

senses.zh: 迅速的，飞快的； n . 急流 ；<衍生词> rapidly
